the whole list opens when the pointer rests on "and N more" local QUEST_URL = 'https://aa-classic.com/database/quests/' local CRAFT_URL = 'https://sermeatball.com/tools/crafting/' -- The lines typed in by editors: the data page Module:Data/Sources (one entry per item ID) and the source= parameter -- of the template (lines separated by ;;) local function typedLines(id, param) local lines = {} local ok, data = pcall(require, 'Module:Data/Sources') if ok and type(data) == 'table' then local e = data[tonumber(id)] if type(e) == 'string' then e = { e } end if type(e) == 'table' then for _, t in ipairs(e) do if trim(t) ~= '' then lines[#lines + 1] = trim(t) end end end end for part in (tostring(param or '') .. ']') end -- One group (Crafting, Quest rewards): the first SHOW entries, then "and N more" that opens the whole list local function sourceGroup(root, title, rows, class, url) if type(rows) ~= 'table' or #rows == 0 then return end local g = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-group') local head = g:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-head') head:tag('span'):addClass('aa-src-name'):wikitext(title .. (#rows > 1 and (' (' .. #rows .. ')') or '')) for i = 1, math.min(SHOW, #rows) do sourceLine(g, class, url, rows[i]) end if #rows > SHOW then local more = g:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-more') more:tag('span'):addClass('aa-src-morelabel'):wikitext('and ' .. only what is confirmed local ARMOR_SLOT = { [1] = 'Head', [3] = 'Chest', [4] = 'Waist', [5] = 'Legs', [6] = 'Hands', [7] = 'Feet' } local CATEGORY_SLOT = { Necklace = 'Neck', Ring = 'Finger', Earring = 'Ear', Shield = 'Left-Hand Shield', Bow = 'Ranged Weapon', Scepter = 'Right-Hand Wpn', Nodachi = '2H Weapon' } local function round(x) return math.floor(x + 0.5) end -- the damage / healing number of an item effect is orange in the game ("dealing 850 Magic Damage"); the data -- has it without a colour code. Numbers that already have a colour are left alone. local function orangeNumbers(text) text = tostring(text or '') return (text:gsub('(%f[%a](%a+) )(%d[%d,%.]*)', function(pre, word, num) local w = word:lower() if w == 'dealing' or w == 'restoring' or w == 'healing' or w == 'absorbing' or w == 'restores' then return pre .. '|nc;' .. num .. '|r' end end)) end -- { {label, value, plus}, ... } of the weapon / armour at grade g (0 = Basic ... 12 = Eternal) local function equipRows(eq, g) local rows = {} local pct = GRADE_PCT[g] local main = GRADE_MAIN[g] local level = tonumber(eq.ilvl) or 0 if type(eq.w) == 'table' then -- the game shows DPS with one decimal and the attack powers rounded down (Legendary staff: DPS 739.2, Magic Attack +844) if (eq.w[1] or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'DPS', string.format('%.1f', eq.w[1] * main / 100) } end if (eq.w[2] or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Magic Attack', math.floor(eq.w[2] * main / 100), true } end if (eq.w[3] or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Healing Power', math.floor(eq.w[3] * main / 100), true } end end if eq.ar then local base = math.floor(level ^ 1.1 * 85 + 100) local cov = (eq.cov or 100) / 100 rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Defense', math.floor(base * (main / 100) * (eq.ar / 100) * cov) } if (eq.mr or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Magic Defense', math.floor(base * (main / 100) * (eq.mr / 100) * cov) } end end if type(eq.wt) == 'table' then local count, sum = 0, 0 for _, w in ipairs(eq.wt) do if w > 0 then count = count + 1 end sum = sum + w end if sum > 0 then local p = (count == 1 and 3) or (count == 2 and 1.5) or 1 local unit = 350 * 0.01 * level * p ^ (1 / 1.1) * (eq.wp and 10 or 90) * 0.01 * (eq.wp and 100 or (eq.cov or 100)) * 0.01 for i, w in ipairs(eq.wt) do if w > 0 then -- rounded to a whole number first, then the weapon's stat multiplier, rounded again (checked: Legendary staff 59 / 116) local t = math.floor(count * unit * w / sum * pct * 0.01 + 0.5) rows[#rows + 1] = { STAT_NAMES[i], math.floor(t * (eq.sm or 100) * 0.01 + 0.5) } end end end end return rows end local function statLines(root, eq, g, top) local rows = equipRows(eq, g) local rowsTop = top and equipRows(eq, top) or nil if #rows == 0 then return false end for i, r in ipairs(rows) do local v = (r[3] and '+' or '') .. r[2] if rowsTop and rowsTop[i] and rowsTop[i][2] ~= r[2] then v = v .. ' ~ ' .. (r[3] and '+' or '') .. rowsTop[i][2] end local line = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-stat') line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-item-statname'):wikitext(r[1]) line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-item-statval'):wikitext(' ' .. v) end return true end -- The card from ready data d = { name, grade, category, icon, over, desc, use, bind, req } -- opts: float, hook (see coloured), use (replaces the Use text), bind (true = show "Untradeable" with a line under it), -- sources (true = the "Obtained from" part, only Template:Consumable asks for it), id, source (lines typed in the template) function p.render(frame, d, opts) opts = opts or {} local name = trim(d.name) local grade = trim(d.grade) local eq = type(d.eq) == 'table' and d.eq or nil -- weapons, armour, accessories (see sync_wiki_data.py equipment_info) local ship = type(d.ship) == 'table' and d.ship or nil -- ship gear: cannons, sails, figureheads (sync_wiki_data.py ship_info) -- grade= on an equipment card shows the card of that grade (the grade of a drop or craft is chosen later) local pick = trim(opts.grade) if (eq or ship) and GRADE_ID[pick:lower()] then grade = GRADES[GRADE_ID[pick:lower()]] end local hasGrade = not (grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any') if not hasGrade then grade = 'Basic' end -- no grade: Basic look, and no grade line local category = trim(d.category) local use = trim(opts.use) if use == '' then use = trim(d.use) end local bind = BIND[trim(d.bind)] if type(d.eq) == 'table' then use = orangeNumbers(use) end local float = trim(opts.float):lower() if not FLOATS[float] then float = '' end local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-item') if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then root:addClass('aa-item-float') end if float == 'right' then root:addClass('aa-item-right') end if float ~= '' then root:attr('style', FLOATS[float]) end -- header: icon, category, grade, name local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-head') head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-icon'):wikitext(IconName.icon({ args = { name, grade, size = 48, file = d.icon, over = d.over } })) local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-title') if category ~= '' then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-cat'):wikitext(esc(category)) end if hasGrade then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-grade'):wikitext( frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(grade) } }) elseif eq and eq.gr then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-grade aa-item-gradevar'):wikitext('Grade varies') end title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-name'):wikitext( frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(name) } }) root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep') -- "Untradeable" only where the card asks for it (opts.bind); the required level is not shown -- the grade the stats are calculated for: the grade of the card (fixed grade or grade=), otherwise Basic up to the best grade local gradeId = hasGrade and GRADE_ID[grade:lower()] or nil local topId = nil if eq and not gradeId then gradeId = 0 topId = eq.maxg and GRADE_ID[trim(eq.maxg):lower()] or nil if topId == 0 then topId = nil end end if ship and not gradeId then gradeId = 0 end local info = false if eq and tonumber(d.req) then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-line'):wikitext('Req. Level: ' .. tonumber(d.req)) info = true end if bind and (opts.bind or eq or ship) then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-line'):wikitext(esc(bind)) info = true end if info then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep') end -- the line under these lines if eq then -- equipment: slot, stats of the grade, best grade local slot = (eq.sl and ARMOR_SLOT[eq.sl]) or CATEGORY_SLOT[category] if slot then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-line'):wikitext(slot) end local stats = statLines(root, eq, gradeId, topId) if slot or stats then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep') end if GRADE_ID[trim(eq.maxg):lower()] and (eq.gr or hasGrade) then local atMax = GRADE_ID[trim(eq.maxg):lower()] == gradeId and hasGrade root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-maxgrade'):wikitext(atMax and 'Max Grade' or ('Maximum Grade(~' .. esc(eq.maxg) .. ')')) end end local descText = d.desc if ship and type(ship.d) == 'table' and ship.d[(gradeId or 0) + 1] and ship.d[(gradeId or 0) + 1] ~= '' then descText = ship.d[(gradeId or 0) + 1] end local body = paragraphs(descText, 'aa-item-desc', opts.hook) if body then root:node(body) end local useBox = paragraphs(use, 'aa-item-green') if useBox then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-label'):wikitext('Use:') root:node(useBox) end if ship and category == 'Sail' then -- every sail in the game has this line root:node(paragraphs('Use a Crest Stamp to add custom designs to sails.', 'aa-item-desc')) end -- "Equip effect": the effect of the grade when it differs per grade, otherwise the fixed one local effText = nil if eq then effText = eq.be if type(eq.gbe) == 'table' and hasGrade and eq.gbe[gradeId + 1] and eq.gbe[gradeId + 1] ~= '' then effText = eq.gbe[gradeId + 1] end elseif ship and type(ship.e) == 'table' and ship.e[gradeId + 1] and ship.e[gradeId + 1] ~= '' then effText = ship.e[gradeId + 1] end local effBox = effText and paragraphs(effText, 'aa-item-effect') if effBox then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-label'):wikitext('Equip effect') root:node(effBox) end if eq then local proc = paragraphs(orangeNumbers(eq.proc), 'aa-item-effect') if proc then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-label'):wikitext('Combo Effect') root:node(proc) end if type(eq.sets) == 'table' and #eq.sets > 0 then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-setname'):wikitext(esc(trim(eq.set)) .. ' Set') root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-seteffect'):wikitext('Set Effect') for _, b in ipairs(eq.sets) do local box = paragraphs('(' .. tostring(b.n or '?') .. 'Set) ' .. tostring(b.t or ''), 'aa-item-effect aa-item-setbonus') if box then root:node(box) end end end if eq.ns then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-nosell'):wikitext('Cannot Sell') end end if opts.sources then sourcesPart(root, d, opts) end return tostring(root) end function p.card(frame) local a = frame.args local d = Store.get('Cards', a.id) local name = d and trim(d.name) or fetched(a.name) if name == '' then return '' end local data if d then data = d else -- live data (the item is not stored yet) data = { name = name, grade = fetched(a.grade), category = fetched(a.category), icon = fetched(a.icon), over = fetched(a.over), desc = fetched(a.desc), use = fetched(a.cuse), bind = fetched(a.bind), req = fetched(a.req) } end return p.render(frame, data, { float = a.float, use = a.use, bind = trim(a.untradeable):lower() ~= 'no', sources = true, id = a.id, source = a.source, grade = a.showgrade }) end return p

local p = {}

-- In-game style card for items that are used up or opened: potions, food, talismans, tokens, crates and
-- every other item that has no card of its own. The category label (Potion, Food ...) comes from the API.
local IconName = require('Module:IconName')
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')   -- data stored on the wiki by sync_wiki_data.py

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

-- Colours of the game's short codes: |nc;...|r is orange, |ni;...|r is yellow, |nd;...|r is light blue ("loot drop rate"). Others show without colour.
local NCODE = { c = 'FF9C27', i = 'F5CB65', d = 'A3E3FD', g = '00F83A' }   -- |ng;...|r is the bright green of warnings like "Offers very low durability"

-- The game marks highlighted words as |cFFRRGGBB...|r; only those parts get a colour.
-- A coloured part may run over several lines: every line gets its own span, so lines can be split afterwards.
-- Codes inside codes (ship gear: |ni;Increases speed |nc;14%|r for 14 seconds|r) are flattened first: the innermost code wins
-- for its part of the text, and a |r that closes nothing is dropped.
local function flatten(text)
	if not text:find('|n%a;[^|]*|n%a;') then return text end
	local out, stack, pos = {}, {}, 1
	local function put(chunk)
		if chunk == '' then return end
		local code = stack[#stack]
		if code and NCODE[code] then out[#out + 1] = '|cFF' .. NCODE[code] .. chunk .. '|r' else out[#out + 1] = chunk end
	end
	while true do
		local s, e, code = text:find('|n(%a);', pos)
		local s2, e2 = text:find('|r', pos, true)
		if not s and not s2 then break end
		if s and (not s2 or s < s2) then
			put(text:sub(pos, s - 1)); stack[#stack + 1] = code; pos = e + 1
		else
			put(text:sub(pos, s2 - 1)); stack[#stack] = nil; pos = e2 + 1
		end
	end
	put(text:sub(pos))
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function coloured(text, hook)
	text = tostring(text or '')
	if not hook then text = flatten(text) end
	-- hook(code, inner) may return ready HTML for a |nX;...|r part (the pet card puts hoverable skills there)
	local toks = {}
	text = text:gsub('|n(%a);(.-)|r', function(code, inner)
		if hook then
			local h = hook(code, inner)
			if h then
				toks[#toks + 1] = h
				return '\1' .. #toks .. '\2'
			end
		end
		if NCODE[code] then return '|cFF' .. NCODE[code] .. inner .. '|r' end
		return inner
	end)
	local out, pos = {}, 1
	while true do
		local s, e, rgb, inner = text:find('|c%x%x(%x%x%x%x%x%x)(.-)|r', pos)
		if not s then break end
		out[#out + 1] = esc(text:sub(pos, s - 1))
		local parts = {}
		for _, seg in ipairs(mw.text.split(inner, '\n', true)) do
			if mw.text.trim(seg) == '' then
				parts[#parts + 1] = seg
			else
				parts[#parts + 1] = '<span style="color:#' .. rgb .. '">' .. esc(seg) .. '</span>'
			end
		end
		out[#out + 1] = table.concat(parts, '\n')
		pos = e + 1
	end
	out[#out + 1] = esc(text:sub(pos))
	local html = table.concat(out)
	if #toks > 0 then
		html = html:gsub('\1(%d+)\2', function(i) return toks[tonumber(i)] end)
	end
	return html
end

-- Where the card sits on the page (float parameter), set inline so it works without the style page
local FLOATS = {
	right = 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 1em;',
	left = 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 1em 0.5em 0;',
	center = 'margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;',
}

-- Binding of the item (bind_type of the API). "normal" shows nothing.
local BIND = {
	soulbound_pickup = 'Untradeable',
	soulbound_unpack = 'Untradeable',
	soulbound_equip = 'Binds when equipped',
}

-- "-@ITEM_NAME(38620)" in a description is the name of that item
local function names(text)
	return (text:gsub('@ITEM_NAME%((%d+)%)', function(id)
		local it = Store.get('Items', id) or Store.get('Cards', id)
		return it and trim(it.name) ~= '' and trim(it.name) or ('Item ' .. id)
	end))
end

-- Text with line breaks: every line its own row, a blank line leaves some space
local function paragraphs(text, class, hook)
	text = trim(names(tostring(text or ''):gsub('\r', '')))
	if text == '' then return nil end
	local box = mw.html.create('div'):addClass(class)
	local gap = false
	for _, line in ipairs(mw.text.split(coloured(text, hook), '\n', true)) do
		line = trim(line)
		if line == '' then
			gap = true
		else
			local row = box:tag('div'):wikitext(line)
			if gap then row:addClass('aa-item-gap') end
			gap = false
		end
	end
	return box
end

local function fetched(s)
	s = trim(s)
	if s:find('class="error"', 1, true) then return '' end
	return s
end

-- shared with Module:Skill
p.paragraphs = paragraphs


-- ---- "Obtained from": crafts and quests that give the item (stored by sync_wiki_data.py) and the lines that editors type in ----
local SHOW = 5   -- entries of a group that are shown in the card; the whole list opens when the pointer rests on "and N more"
local QUEST_URL = 'https://aa-classic.com/database/quests/'
local CRAFT_URL = 'https://sermeatball.com/tools/crafting/'

-- The lines typed in by editors: the data page Module:Data/Sources (one entry per item ID) and the source= parameter
-- of the template (lines separated by ;;)
local function typedLines(id, param)
	local lines = {}
	local ok, data = pcall(require, 'Module:Data/Sources')
	if ok and type(data) == 'table' then
		local e = data[tonumber(id)]
		if type(e) == 'string' then e = { e } end
		if type(e) == 'table' then
			for _, t in ipairs(e) do
				if trim(t) ~= '' then lines[#lines + 1] = trim(t) end
			end
		end
	end
	for part in (tostring(param or '') .. ';;'):gmatch('(.-);;') do
		part = trim(part)
		if part ~= '' then lines[#lines + 1] = part end
	end
	return lines
end

local function sourceLine(parent, class, url, row)
	parent:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-line ' .. class)
		:wikitext('[' .. url .. tostring(row[1]) .. ' ' .. esc(row[2]) .. ']')
end

-- One group (Crafting, Quest rewards): the first SHOW entries, then "and N more" that opens the whole list
local function sourceGroup(root, title, rows, class, url)
	if type(rows) ~= 'table' or #rows == 0 then return end
	local g = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-group')
	local head = g:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-head')
	head:tag('span'):addClass('aa-src-name'):wikitext(title .. (#rows > 1 and (' (' .. #rows .. ')') or ''))
	for i = 1, math.min(SHOW, #rows) do sourceLine(g, class, url, rows[i]) end
	if #rows > SHOW then
		local more = g:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-more')
		more:tag('span'):addClass('aa-src-morelabel'):wikitext('and ' .. (#rows - SHOW) .. ' more')
		local box = more:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-all'):tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-box')
		box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-boxhead'):wikitext(title .. ' (' .. #rows .. ')')
		for _, r in ipairs(rows) do sourceLine(box, class, url, r) end
	end
end

local function sourcesPart(root, d, opts)
	if trim(opts.source):lower() == 'no' then return end
	local typed = typedLines(opts.id, opts.source)
	local hasCraft = type(d.crafts) == 'table' and #d.crafts > 0
	local hasQuest = type(d.quests) == 'table' and #d.quests > 0
	if not (hasCraft or hasQuest or #typed > 0) then return end
	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep')
	local box = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src')
	box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-title'):wikitext('Obtained from')
	sourceGroup(box, 'Crafting', d.crafts, 'aa-src-craft', CRAFT_URL)
	sourceGroup(box, 'Quest rewards', d.quests, 'aa-src-quest', QUEST_URL)
	if #typed > 0 then
		local g = box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-group')
		g:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-head'):tag('span'):addClass('aa-src-name'):wikitext('Other')
		for _, t in ipairs(typed) do g:tag('div'):addClass('aa-src-line aa-src-other'):wikitext(t) end
	end
end

-- ---- Equipment: the stats of a grade, calculated the way aa-classic.com does it (its item page) ----
local GRADES = { [0] = 'Basic', 'Crude', 'Grand', 'Rare', 'Arcane', 'Heroic', 'Unique', 'Celestial', 'Divine', 'Epic', 'Legendary', 'Mythic', 'Eternal' }
local GRADE_PCT = { [0] = 100, 80, 108, 116, 124, 132, 140, 150, 160, 170, 185, 200, 210 }   -- the grade's share of the stats (Strength ...)
-- the grade's share of defense and weapon damage, a different table (checked against the game: Hermit's Footprints Legendary 1838)
-- Eternal is not confirmed, it is shown with the stat share
local GRADE_MAIN = { [0] = 100, 80, 105, 110, 115, 120, 125, 135, 150, 170, 190, 200, 210 }
local GRADE_ID = {}
for i = 0, 12 do GRADE_ID[GRADES[i]:lower()] = i end
local STAT_NAMES = { 'Strength', 'Agility', 'Stamina', 'Intelligence', 'Spirit' }
-- slot of armour (slot_type_id of the data) and of accessories and weapons (category); only what is confirmed
local ARMOR_SLOT = { [1] = 'Head', [3] = 'Chest', [4] = 'Waist', [5] = 'Legs', [6] = 'Hands', [7] = 'Feet' }
local CATEGORY_SLOT = { Necklace = 'Neck', Ring = 'Finger', Earring = 'Ear', Shield = 'Left-Hand Shield', Bow = 'Ranged Weapon',
	Scepter = 'Right-Hand Wpn', Nodachi = '2H Weapon' }

local function round(x) return math.floor(x + 0.5) end

-- the damage / healing number of an item effect is orange in the game ("dealing 850 Magic Damage"); the data
-- has it without a colour code. Numbers that already have a colour are left alone.
local function orangeNumbers(text)
	text = tostring(text or '')
	return (text:gsub('(%f[%a](%a+) )(%d[%d,%.]*)', function(pre, word, num)
		local w = word:lower()
		if w == 'dealing' or w == 'restoring' or w == 'healing' or w == 'absorbing' or w == 'restores' then
			return pre .. '|nc;' .. num .. '|r'
		end
	end))
end

-- { {label, value, plus}, ... } of the weapon / armour at grade g (0 = Basic ... 12 = Eternal)
local function equipRows(eq, g)
	local rows = {}
	local pct = GRADE_PCT[g]
	local main = GRADE_MAIN[g]
	local level = tonumber(eq.ilvl) or 0
	if type(eq.w) == 'table' then
		-- the game shows DPS with one decimal and the attack powers rounded down (Legendary staff: DPS 739.2, Magic Attack +844)
		if (eq.w[1] or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'DPS', string.format('%.1f', eq.w[1] * main / 100) } end
		if (eq.w[2] or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Magic Attack', math.floor(eq.w[2] * main / 100), true } end
		if (eq.w[3] or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Healing Power', math.floor(eq.w[3] * main / 100), true } end
	end
	if eq.ar then
		local base = math.floor(level ^ 1.1 * 85 + 100)
		local cov = (eq.cov or 100) / 100
		rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Defense', math.floor(base * (main / 100) * (eq.ar / 100) * cov) }
		if (eq.mr or 0) > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = { 'Magic Defense', math.floor(base * (main / 100) * (eq.mr / 100) * cov) } end
	end
	if type(eq.wt) == 'table' then
		local count, sum = 0, 0
		for _, w in ipairs(eq.wt) do
			if w > 0 then count = count + 1 end
			sum = sum + w
		end
		if sum > 0 then
			local p = (count == 1 and 3) or (count == 2 and 1.5) or 1
			local unit = 350 * 0.01 * level * p ^ (1 / 1.1) * (eq.wp and 10 or 90) * 0.01 * (eq.wp and 100 or (eq.cov or 100)) * 0.01
			for i, w in ipairs(eq.wt) do
				if w > 0 then
					-- rounded to a whole number first, then the weapon's stat multiplier, rounded again (checked: Legendary staff 59 / 116)
					local t = math.floor(count * unit * w / sum * pct * 0.01 + 0.5)
					rows[#rows + 1] = { STAT_NAMES[i], math.floor(t * (eq.sm or 100) * 0.01 + 0.5) }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return rows
end

local function statLines(root, eq, g, top)
	local rows = equipRows(eq, g)
	local rowsTop = top and equipRows(eq, top) or nil
	if #rows == 0 then return false end
	for i, r in ipairs(rows) do
		local v = (r[3] and '+' or '') .. r[2]
		if rowsTop and rowsTop[i] and rowsTop[i][2] ~= r[2] then v = v .. ' ~ ' .. (r[3] and '+' or '') .. rowsTop[i][2] end
		local line = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-stat')
		line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-item-statname'):wikitext(r[1])
		line:tag('span'):addClass('aa-item-statval'):wikitext(' ' .. v)
	end
	return true
end

-- The card from ready data d = { name, grade, category, icon, over, desc, use, bind, req }
-- opts: float, hook (see coloured), use (replaces the Use text), bind (true = show "Untradeable" with a line under it),
-- sources (true = the "Obtained from" part, only Template:Consumable asks for it), id, source (lines typed in the template)
function p.render(frame, d, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local name = trim(d.name)
	local grade = trim(d.grade)
	local eq = type(d.eq) == 'table' and d.eq or nil   -- weapons, armour, accessories (see sync_wiki_data.py equipment_info)
	local ship = type(d.ship) == 'table' and d.ship or nil   -- ship gear: cannons, sails, figureheads (sync_wiki_data.py ship_info)
	-- grade= on an equipment card shows the card of that grade (the grade of a drop or craft is chosen later)
	local pick = trim(opts.grade)
	if (eq or ship) and GRADE_ID[pick:lower()] then grade = GRADES[GRADE_ID[pick:lower()]] end
	local hasGrade = not (grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any')
	if not hasGrade then grade = 'Basic' end   -- no grade: Basic look, and no grade line
	local category = trim(d.category)
	local use = trim(opts.use)
	if use == '' then use = trim(d.use) end
	local bind = BIND[trim(d.bind)]
	if type(d.eq) == 'table' then use = orangeNumbers(use) end

	local float = trim(opts.float):lower()
	if not FLOATS[float] then float = '' end
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-item')
	if float == 'right' or float == 'left' then root:addClass('aa-item-float') end
	if float == 'right' then root:addClass('aa-item-right') end
	if float ~= '' then root:attr('style', FLOATS[float]) end

	-- header: icon, category, grade, name
	local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-head')
	head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-icon'):wikitext(IconName.icon({ args = { name, grade, size = 48, file = d.icon, over = d.over } }))
	local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-title')
	if category ~= '' then title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-cat'):wikitext(esc(category)) end
	if hasGrade then
		title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-grade'):wikitext(
			frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(grade) } })
	elseif eq and eq.gr then
		title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-grade aa-item-gradevar'):wikitext('Grade varies')
	end
	title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-name'):wikitext(
		frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, esc(name) } })

	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep')

	-- "Untradeable" only where the card asks for it (opts.bind); the required level is not shown
	-- the grade the stats are calculated for: the grade of the card (fixed grade or grade=), otherwise Basic up to the best grade
	local gradeId = hasGrade and GRADE_ID[grade:lower()] or nil
	local topId = nil
	if eq and not gradeId then
		gradeId = 0
		topId = eq.maxg and GRADE_ID[trim(eq.maxg):lower()] or nil
		if topId == 0 then topId = nil end
	end
	if ship and not gradeId then gradeId = 0 end
	local info = false
	if eq and tonumber(d.req) then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-line'):wikitext('Req. Level: ' .. tonumber(d.req))
		info = true
	end
	if bind and (opts.bind or eq or ship) then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-line'):wikitext(esc(bind))
		info = true
	end
	if info then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep') end   -- the line under these lines
	if eq then   -- equipment: slot, stats of the grade, best grade
		local slot = (eq.sl and ARMOR_SLOT[eq.sl]) or CATEGORY_SLOT[category]
		if slot then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-line'):wikitext(slot) end
		local stats = statLines(root, eq, gradeId, topId)
		if slot or stats then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-sep') end
		if GRADE_ID[trim(eq.maxg):lower()] and (eq.gr or hasGrade) then
			local atMax = GRADE_ID[trim(eq.maxg):lower()] == gradeId and hasGrade
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-maxgrade'):wikitext(atMax and 'Max Grade' or ('Maximum Grade(~' .. esc(eq.maxg) .. ')'))
		end
	end
	local descText = d.desc
	if ship and type(ship.d) == 'table' and ship.d[(gradeId or 0) + 1] and ship.d[(gradeId or 0) + 1] ~= '' then
		descText = ship.d[(gradeId or 0) + 1]
	end
	local body = paragraphs(descText, 'aa-item-desc', opts.hook)
	if body then root:node(body) end

	local useBox = paragraphs(use, 'aa-item-green')
	if useBox then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-label'):wikitext('Use:')
		root:node(useBox)
	end
	if ship and category == 'Sail' then   -- every sail in the game has this line
		root:node(paragraphs('Use a Crest Stamp to add custom designs to sails.', 'aa-item-desc'))
	end
	-- "Equip effect": the effect of the grade when it differs per grade, otherwise the fixed one
	local effText = nil
	if eq then
		effText = eq.be
		if type(eq.gbe) == 'table' and hasGrade and eq.gbe[gradeId + 1] and eq.gbe[gradeId + 1] ~= '' then effText = eq.gbe[gradeId + 1] end
	elseif ship and type(ship.e) == 'table' and ship.e[gradeId + 1] and ship.e[gradeId + 1] ~= '' then
		effText = ship.e[gradeId + 1]
	end
	local effBox = effText and paragraphs(effText, 'aa-item-effect')
	if effBox then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-label'):wikitext('Equip effect')
		root:node(effBox)
	end
	if eq then
		local proc = paragraphs(orangeNumbers(eq.proc), 'aa-item-effect')
		if proc then
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-label'):wikitext('Combo Effect')
			root:node(proc)
		end
		if type(eq.sets) == 'table' and #eq.sets > 0 then
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-setname'):wikitext(esc(trim(eq.set)) .. ' Set')
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-seteffect'):wikitext('Set Effect')
			for _, b in ipairs(eq.sets) do
				local box = paragraphs('(' .. tostring(b.n or '?') .. 'Set) ' .. tostring(b.t or ''), 'aa-item-effect aa-item-setbonus')
				if box then root:node(box) end
			end
		end
		if eq.ns then root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-item-nosell'):wikitext('Cannot Sell') end
	end
	if opts.sources then sourcesPart(root, d, opts) end
	return tostring(root)
end

function p.card(frame)
	local a = frame.args
	local d = Store.get('Cards', a.id)
	local name = d and trim(d.name) or fetched(a.name)
	if name == '' then
		return '<!-- Consumable: no data, the API request failed or the item id is wrong -->'
	end
	local data
	if d then
		data = d
	else
		-- live data (the item is not stored yet)
		data = { name = name, grade = fetched(a.grade), category = fetched(a.category), icon = fetched(a.icon),
			over = fetched(a.over), desc = fetched(a.desc), use = fetched(a.cuse), bind = fetched(a.bind),
			req = fetched(a.req) }
	end
	return p.render(frame, data, { float = a.float, use = a.use, bind = trim(a.untradeable):lower() ~= 'no',
		sources = true, id = a.id, source = a.source, grade = a.showgrade })
end

return p
